hints: The client fails to reach the service after a network interruption.
Look at the base_service package - the prepare_request method handles the URL.
When the service URL ends with a slash and the request path also starts with a slash, the URL ends up with a double slash, which some servers treat as a different path.
brief.lesson: Removing the trailing-slash strip restores the original URL concatenation, preserving the intended path even when the service URL already ends with a slash.
